instruction: Enable VS Code's minimap feature and set its maximum column width to 80 characters.

metadata.explanation: This task requires configuring two related VS Code minimap settings: enabling the minimap and setting its maximum column width. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify both configurations.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both instruction requirements - enabling minimap (editor.minimap.enabled: true) and setting max column width to 80 (editor.minimap.maxColumn: 80)
Correct getter logic: get_vm_file properly retrieves VS Code settings from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Correct metric logic: check_json_settings correctly loads JSON and verifies all expected key-value pairs with proper equality checking
Proper data flow: Getter returns file path, metric accepts file path and loads JSON - semantically compatible
State accessibility: VS Code settings are persisted to disk, no postconfig needed for verification
Expected values are semantically correct for the task requirements
